items.title: Man admits sexually assaulting woman drugged by husband
items.summary: The husband is accused of inviting 13 other men to abuse her at their family home in Greater Manchester.

items.title: Widdecombe murder suspect accused of terror plot against Farage 'researched number of prominent people', court told
items.summary: The man accused of murdering Ann Widdecombe has appeared in court charged with preparing acts of terrorism, including against Nigel Farage.

items.title: Royal Mail plans to cut 2,500 jobs
items.summary: The postal service firm wants to cut head office and other non-frontline jobs by the end of 2027.

items.title: Husband appears in court charged with murder of Norfolk GP
items.summary: A husband charged with murdering his wife, who was found dead at a property in Norfolk, has appeared in court.

items.title: Husband appears in court accused of GP's murder
items.summary: Mark Cain is charged with the murder of Dr Hannah Terry, whose body was found at her home.

items.title: Reform UK inquiry clears own advisers over donations sting
items.summary: Reform UK's internal inquiry following an undercover sting has cleared two of its senior advisers of wrongdoing, the party says.
